label: Free trial ended

stages.title: Your free trial is over
stages.body: Thanks for trying wordsmith for five days. It runs on cloud servers that cost real money every month, so keeping it going takes a DOGS membership: $1 a month on Buy Me a Coffee.

stages.title: Alright, what about 50 cents a month?
stages.body: Come on, man. That's two quarters a month for a cloud app that costs me money to host.

stages.title: Okay. Well, same to you, pal.
stages.body: But honestly? I've been broke before too. I'm broke right now too. The offer stands whenever you're ready.

stillLocked: Not approved yet. Memberships are checked by hand, usually within a day.
manual: Memberships are approved by hand, so access comes back once yours is checked, usually within a day.
